title: Content-v1 owner capture failure at turn close silently drops source attribution (no bounded retry, no local notice); align execution-observability doc
outcome: When the content-v1 owner capture at turn close fails for a deadline or a transient reason (spawn or version-probe failure, named root changed during capture, binary replaced), TermAl keeps a bounded retry, or at least publishes a fixed local notice, instead of silently sending EngramRuntimeClosingSource::Unavailable and dropping the turn's registered-check baselines. docs/features/execution-observability.md (around lines 66-78) matches the owner-backed capture behaviour.
